name: Spirit of Fire's On Enter draws seven cards
notes: Spirit of Fire is the default starting champion for every fixture in this file (and every other one authored this session) -- its 'On Enter: Draw seven cards' trigger fires during pregame setup, before any scripted action runs, which is exactly why every other fixture's initial gamestate already shows a 7-card starting hand. This fixture makes that implicit, constantly-reconfirmed coverage explicit for the backlog tool rather than leaving it uncredited. RegressionEvaluateAssertion can't run against the raw step-0 snapshot (GetZoneObject() isn't defined that early -- the full engine only bootstraps once an action is processed), so one harmless P1 Main-phase pass is included purely to produce an assertable step; it cascades P1 through to P2's Main phase but never touches P1's own hand count.
